description: This Alberta water-treatment information source describes alternatives for removing iron from water. The abstract identifies air injection with filtration, shock chlorination, manganese greensand filtration, water softening, and chlorination with filtration. The physical processes are directly relevant to water-treatment equipment, but the metadata does not provide removal efficiencies, process dimensions, operating limits or a specific simulation application. Coverage is the Alberta technical guidance context; no monitored facility or experimental sample population is identified. The package lists a revised March 2015 PDF and EPUB, plus a superseded March 2012 PDF. These are grouped as editions and representations of one source, with differences between the editions unverified. Full descriptive metadata and original package identifiers are available through the Canadian Urban Data Catalogue. It labels these sources Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and actual document access are not stated or tested. No document body was fetched. Related editions and component representations are retained together; the technical contents and fitness for a particular model remain unverified.
